entry_state: Apple's annual and quarterly share constraints permit distinct intermediate quantities; monetary flows and RSUs impose further restrictions. Plan reserve capacity, common shares delivered and individual award rights differ. Specific agreement terms govern settlement and vesting; the performance form leaves inputs blank, while the proxy supplies one named grant population's schedule.
exit_state: Performance awards require a supplied rank convention, proper return windows, schedule, negative-return cap, surviving rights and settlement terms. General and CEO forms preserve different units after severance but retain later delivery; their applicability to a specific award is separate from identifying the source version. Compound financing classification follows.
